summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, reporting its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The press release and accompanying MD&A and financial statements detail revenue of $267.5 million, net loss of $96.0 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $13.8 million. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review, is announced. The filing is a routine earnings report under foreign private issuer rules, with no deal terms or board actions involving corporate structural changes.
